secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key from Google AI Studio (https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). Not required to boot — the app does not currently import it, but it is listed in .env.example for future AI features.

secrets.name: HESABPAY_API_KEY
secrets.description: HesabPay payment gateway API key from the HesabPay dashboard. Optional — the app runs in demo/sandbox mode without it.

secrets.name: HESABPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: HesabPay webhook signing secret for verifying payment callbacks. Optional.

secrets.name: FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: Firebase project ID for cloud persistence and auth. Optional — the app uses in-memory state without it.

secrets.name: FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL
secrets.description: Firebase service account client email. Optional.

secrets.name: FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase service account private key. Optional.
